तंसु

TAṀSU . A King of Pūruvaṁśa. He was the son of matināra and father of īlina a King. (Chapter 94, Ādi Parva).

तनय

TANAYA . A place of habitation of ancient bhārata. Śloka 64, Chapter 9, bhīṣma parva).

तन्दुलिकाश्रम

TANDULIKĀŚRAMA . A sacred place of ancient bhārata. He who visits this place would enter Brahmaloka. (Śloka 43, Chapter 82, Vana Parva).

तंगण

TAṄGAṆA . An ancient place of habitation of bhārata. (Śloka 64, Chapter 9, bhīṣma parva).

तन्त्रिपाल

TANTRIPĀLA . The false name adopted by sahadeva when he lived incognito in the city of virāṭa. (Śloka 9, Chapter 3, virāṭa Parva).

तन्तु

TANTU . A Brahmavādī son of viśvāmitra. (Chapter 4, anuśāsana parva).

तनु

TANU . An ancient sage. This sage lived in the palace of King vīradyumna for a long time. (Chapters 127 and 128, śānti Parva).
